headline: Delfina Gómez Sends 2027 Economic Package Worth 433 Billion Pesos
summary: The 2027 Economic Package totals 433 billion pesos and includes no new debt for a fourth consecutive year. It allocates 20.4 billion pesos to public investment and raises social programs by 7%.
why: Mexico's federal budget sets public spending and borrowing plans that influence peso-denominated bonds and the country's fiscal outlook.
original_headline: Envía Delfina Gómez Paquete Económico 2027 por 433 mil millones de pesos
